m6ControlledActivation.head: b23dfc0eb1eb07ad3fd85fe89399c7fb5e40c5c0
m6ControlledActivation.contract: controlled straight/right/left production crossings are default-off, preserve fixed pool and stable token/slot, report zero teleports, survive camera movement during connector crossing, and leave default laneAuthority authored-local-lanes

m7JunctionReservation.head: dcb08288ea797e7016bcdb3858299a85549a7259
m7JunctionReservation.contract: conflicting compiler-route tokens reserve before connector entry, wait on the incoming lane, normally clear once inside, release on exit/forced controlled stop, recover stale ownership deterministically, preserve fixed pool/identity and keep default civilian authority on authored local lanes

nextTask.goal: Generalize the proven pure route, materialization, lifecycle and reservation contracts into a deterministic multi-agent civilian route runtime substrate without flipping production default movement yet; this is the final bounded substrate before default activation.
actions: Extract/reuse deterministic macro-population-to-local-route seeding without copying macro centres or phases into ongoing local geometry authority.
Create a multi-agent runtime route registry that advances stable route agents from compiler lane/connector geometry and shares one M7 junction reservation registry.
Expose route materialization tokens for the multi-agent registry while preserving stable token identity, bounded population and existing fixed materialization pool semantics.
Ensure every connector entry uses deterministic reservation/yield; waiting remains on the incoming lane and cars already inside normally clear the connector.
Keep legacy behavior/steering from overwriting routeActive x/y in the multi-agent substrate.
Keep the new multi-agent substrate explicitly non-default in M8.1; authored-local-lanes remain production default until a later M8 activation task has focused/browser soak evidence.
Do not mutate MacroTrafficPoliceSystem load/phases yet beyond diagnostics; compatibility projection remains output-only in M8.1.

Add focused deterministic tests for population conservation, multi-token reservation conflicts, stable identity/materialization metadata, teardown cleanup and zero use of macro centres as driving coordinates.
acceptance: multi-agent runtime population equals the seeded macro population or reports explicit unseeded records with conservation
stable route token identity survives lane/connector/lane progression for multiple agents
conflicting agents cannot enter the same reserved junction simultaneously
waiting agents remain at incoming lane end and inside agents keep moving
teardown releases reservations and route state without growing the materialization pool
routeActive coordinates come only from compiler lane/connector geometry
legacy behavior/steering cannot overwrite routeActive x/y

default civilian traffic remains authored-local-lanes throughout M8.1

legacy edge phase becomes physical route identity
